def is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when name is one path component inside a directory: non-empty, no '/' or '\\', not '.' or '..', and no NUL."""
    ex is_plain_name("notes.txt") == True
    ex is_plain_name("../secret") == False
    ex is_plain_name("a/b") == False
    ex is_plain_name("") == False
    if name == "" or name == "." or name == "..":
        return False
    if "/" in name or "\\" in name or "\0" in name:
        return False
    return True

def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str uses fs:
    """Text of the first name in names that reads as a plain file inside the notes directory, or "" when none can be read. Names that fail is_plain_name are skipped, and reads go through fs.sub("notes") so no name can reach a file outside notes."""
    post out == "" or names.len() > 0
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        for name in names:
            if not is_plain_name(name):
                continue
            text = fs.read_text(name) else continue
            return text
    return ""
